subject: BrightPath identity & access — evidence requests and next steps
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath identity & access — evidence requests and next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so procurement and security have a clear intake path.

Summary of what we heard (from today):
- BrightPath needs to validate Redwood for a HIPAA-covered workflow and wants confirmation on SOC 2 status and evidence.
- You use Okta as the IdP and want SCIM provisioning plus RBAC controls for multi-tenant access.
- Procurement will need our standard BAA and an initial security questionnaire answered.

What we can provide this week:
1) ID & access evidence checklist (attached) — outlines the specific artifacts we typically share (SSO metadata, SCIM endpoints, RBAC matrix, admin screenshots, audit logs).
2) A pre-filled vendor security questionnaire template (we'll accept your PDF back) — attach your completed copy for our security review.
3) BAA template (we can share our standard form; legal is happy to review redlines).
4) SAML metadata + SCIM endpoints sample — Marissa will attach the technical metadata for your IdP team.

Action items / asks for BrightPath:
- Can you confirm the security contact who will own the questionnaire (name + email)?
- Please share a copy of your completed security questionnaire and any timelines for procurement review.
- If you have a required SOC 2 timeframe (e.g., need a completed Type II), please flag that so we can prioritize evidence.

Tentative timeline: if we get the questionnaire back by Fri (5/28) we can target an internal security review by the following week and deliver tech artifacts for a staging SCIM test the week of 6/7.

I've attached the redwood-iam-evidence-template.xlsx to make the intake straightforward. Let me know if you want to add folks to the thread.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-iam-evidence-template.xlsx (Excel)
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpathhealth.com, security@brightpathhealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath identity & access — evidence requests and next steps

Thanks, Rohan — good summary. I looped in procurement and our security lead. A few quick answers:

- Security contact: Marco Liu (security@brightpathhealth.com). He will coordinate the questionnaire details.
- SOC 2: we currently require vendors to provide SOC 2 Type II or a SOC 2 bridge letter if Type II is in progress. We are still finalizing our internal timelines but will flag if Type II completion is a hard requirement.
- HIPAA / BAA: BrightPath requires a signed BAA before we move PHI into a vendor system. Please send your standard BAA and we'll route to legal.

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (BrightPath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — it's a short form covering policies, encryption, admin controls, and audit logs. We'll aim to have this back to you by next Wednesday (6/2) but will confirm after procurement sync.

One more technical note: for SAML we need attribute mapping for: email, given_name, family_name, role, department. For SCIM we typically test create/update for users and groups and expect bulk provisioning to be supported.

Thanks — I cc'd procurement so they have visibility.

—Elena
Elena Morales
Director, IT Security | BrightPath Health
elena.morales@brightpathhealth.com

Attachments: BrightPath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF)
